interviewProtocol.title: Confirm the Exact Contract
actions: Record every round, duration, platform, language, library, internet, and AI rule.
Mark every unconfirmed field UNKNOWN.
Map the confirmed loop to existing sourced sessions only.

interviewProtocol.title: Switch to the Matching Sprint
actions: Use the 14-day or 7-day schedule below instead of the weekly plan.
Replace at most two sessions when recruiter evidence requires it.
Keep every technical task tied to its named external source.

interviewProtocol.title: Repair One Failed Gate
actions: Introduce no new topic.
Re-run one failed high-impact gate with its named source.
Rehearse the opening and one candidate-owned project defense.
Stop after the single retest.

interviewProtocol.title: Close the Loop
actions: Test links, editor, audio, camera, charger, and backup connection.
Place water, paper, and the recruiter contact nearby.
Stop technical work by 21:00 local time.
Put the first link and start time in view.

interviewProtocol.title: Warm Up Only
actions: Deliver the familiar opening once.
Review the five confirmed priorities.
Review tool and confidentiality boundaries.
Join ten minutes early.

interviewProtocol.title: Reset
actions: Write questions and facts for five minutes.
Do not search answers between same-day rounds.
Eat, drink, move, and start the next round clean.
Debrief only after the full loop.

fourteen_day.extra: Finish with one short evidence defense.
Do not catch up or add work.
Complete exactly one rescue from the lowest failed surface.

seven_day.extra: Complete only one rescue from the failed surface, then assemble the confirmed interview packet.

final_72_hours: Rehearse the opening and one project defense.
Confirm tools and logistics, then stop.
